versos.hebraico: וּבִשְׁנַת֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־נְבָ֑ט מָלַ֥ךְ אֲבִיָּ֖ם עַל־יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat began Abijam to reign over Judah.
controles.kjv: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
controles.livre: No ano dezoito do rei Jeroboão filho de Nebate, Abião começou a reinar sobre Judá.

versos.hebraico: שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת־אֲבִישָׁלֽוֹם׃

controles.web: He reigned three years in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
controles.kjv: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
controles.livre: Reinou três anos em Jerusalém. O nome de sua mãe era Maaca, filha  de Absalão.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּכָל־חַטֹּ֥אות אָבִ֖יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֣ה לְפָנָ֑יו וְלֹא־הָיָ֨ה לְבָב֤וֹ שָׁלֵם֙ עִם־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו כִּלְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽיו׃

controles.web: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father.
controles.kjv: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as the heart of David his father.
controles.livre: E andou em todos os pecados de seu pai, que havia este feito antes dele; e não foi seu coração completo com o SENHOR seu Deus, como o coração do seu pai Davi.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֚י לְמַ֣עַן דָּוִ֔ד נָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֥יו ל֛וֹ נִ֖יר בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְהָקִ֤ים אֶת־בְּנוֹ֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וּֽלְהַעֲמִ֖יד אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

controles.web: Nevertheless for David’s sake, Yahweh his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem;
controles.kjv: Nevertheless for David’s sake did the Lord his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
controles.livre: Mas por amor de Davi, deu-lhe o SENHOR seu Deus lâmpada em Jerusalém, levantando-lhe a seu filho depois dele, e sustentando a Jerusalém:

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה דָוִ֛ד אֶת־הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־סָ֞ר מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֗הוּ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֔יו רַ֕ק בִּדְבַ֖ר אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַחִתִּֽי׃

controles.web: because David did that which was right in the eyes of Yahweh, and didn’t turn aside from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
controles.kjv: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
controles.livre: Porquanto Davi havia feito o que era correto diante dos olhos do SENHOR, e de nenhuma coisa que lhe mandasse se havia apartado em todos os dias de sua vida, exceto o negócio de Urias Heteu.

versos.hebraico: וּמִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֧ה בֵין־רְחַבְעָ֛ם וּבֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָ֖ם כָּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃

controles.web: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
controles.kjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
controles.livre: E havia guerra entre Roboão e Jeroboão todos os dias de sua vida.

versos.hebraico: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י אֲבִיָּם֙ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה הֲלֽוֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּמִלְחָמָ֥ה הָיְתָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין אֲבִיָּ֖ם וּבֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָֽם׃

controles.web: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
controles.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
controles.livre: Os demais dos feitos de Abião, e todas as coisas que fez, não estão escritas no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá? E havia guerra entre Abião e Jeroboão.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אֲבִיָּם֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

controles.web: Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: E dormiu Abião com seus pais, e sepultaram-no na cidade de Davi: e reinou Asa seu filho em seu lugar.

versos.hebraico: וּבִשְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְיָרָבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֥ךְ אָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Asa to reign over Judah.
controles.kjv: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
controles.livre: No ano vinte de Jeroboão rei de Israel, Asa começou a reinar sobre Judá.

versos.hebraico: וְאַרְבָּעִ֤ים וְאַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת־אֲבִישָׁלֽוֹם׃

controles.web: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
controles.kjv: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
controles.livre: E reinou quarenta e um anos em Jerusalém; o nome de sua avó  era Maaca, filha de Absalão.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אָסָ֛א הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּדָוִ֖ד אָבִֽיו׃

controles.web: Asa did that which was right in the eyes of Yahweh, as did David his father.
controles.kjv: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, as did David his father.
controles.livre: E Asa fez o que era correto diante dos olhos do SENHOR, como o seu pai Davi.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲבֵ֥ר הַקְּדֵשִׁ֖ים מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּ֨סַר֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַגִּלֻּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
controles.kjv: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
controles.livre: Porque tirou os sodomitas da terra, e tirou todas as imundícies que seus pais haviam feito.

versos.hebraico: וְגַ֣ם׀ אֶת־מַעֲכָ֣ה אִמּ֗וֹ וַיְסִרֶ֨הָ֙ מִגְּבִירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָ֥ה מִפְלֶ֖צֶת לָאֲשֵׁרָ֑ה וַיִּכְרֹ֤ת אָסָא֙ אֶת־מִפְלַצְתָּ֔הּ וַיִּשְׂרֹ֖ף בְּנַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Also Maacah his mother he removed from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; and Asa cut down her image, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
controles.kjv: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.
controles.livre: E também tirou de sua avó Maaca a posição de rainha-mãe, porque havia feito um ídolo num bosque. Além disso, Asa destruiu o ídolo dela, e o queimou junto ao ribeiro de Cedrom.

versos.hebraico: וְהַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־סָ֑רוּ רַ֣ק לְבַב־אָסָ֗א הָיָ֥ה שָׁלֵ֛ם עִם־יְהוָ֖ה כָּל־יָמָֽיו׃

controles.web: But the high places were not taken away: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with Yahweh all his days.
controles.kjv: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with the Lord all his days.
controles.livre: Porém os altos não foram tirados. Contudo, o coração de Asa foi completo com o SENHOR durante toda a sua vida.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֵא֙ אֶת־קָדְשֵׁ֣י אָבִ֔יו וקדשו בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כֶּ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב וְכֵלִֽים׃

controles.web: He brought into Yahweh’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
controles.kjv: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the Lord, silver, and gold, and vessels.
controles.livre: Também trouxe à casa do SENHOR o que o seu pai havia dedicado, e o que ele dedicou: ouro, e prata, e utensílios.

versos.hebraico: וּמִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֜ה בֵּ֣ין אָסָ֗א וּבֵ֛ין בַּעְשָׁ֥א מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל־יְמֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
controles.kjv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
controles.livre: E havia guerra entre Asa e Baasa, rei de Israel, durante todo o tempo deles.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַל בַּעְשָׁ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַל־יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּ֖בֶן אֶת־הָרָמָ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֗י תֵּ֚ת יֹצֵ֣א וָבָ֔א לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
controles.kjv: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
controles.livre: E Baasa, rei de Israel, subiu contra Judá, e edificou Ramá, para não deixar sair nem entrar a ninguém de Asa, rei de Judá.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אָ֠סָא אֶת־כָּל־הַכֶּ֨סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֜ב הַֽנּוֹתָרִ֣ים׀ בְּאוֹצְר֣וֹת בֵּית־יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶת־אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית מלך וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיַד־עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֞ם הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א אֶל־בֶּן־הֲ֠דַד בֶּן־טַבְרִמֹּ֤ן בֶּן־חֶזְיוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם הַיֹּשֵׁ֥ב בְּדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants; and king Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,
controles.kjv: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben–hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
controles.livre: Então Asa tomou toda a prata e ouro que havia restado nos tesouros da casa do SENHOR, e os tesouros da casa real, entregou-os nas mãos de seus servos, e o rei Asa os enviou a Ben-Hadade, filho de Tabrimom, filho de Heziom, rei da Síria, o qual residia em Damasco, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: בְּרִית֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֔ךָ בֵּ֥ין אָבִ֖י וּבֵ֣ין אָבִ֑יךָ הִנֵּה֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתִּֽי לְךָ֥ שֹׁ֨חַד֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב לֵ֣ךְ הָפֵ֗רָה אֶת־בְּרִֽיתְךָ֙ אֶת־בַּעְשָׁ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵעָלָֽי׃

controles.web: “There is a treaty between me and you, between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”
controles.kjv: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
controles.livre: Aliança há entre mim e ti, e entre meu pai e o teu; eis que eu te envio um presente de prata e ouro. Vai, e rompe a tua aliança com Baasa rei de Israel, para que me deixe.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע בֶּן־הֲדַ֜ד אֶל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח אֶת־שָׂרֵ֨י הַחֲיָלִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ֙ עַל־עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־עִיּ֣וֹן וְאֶת־דָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת אָבֵ֣ל בֵּֽית־מַעֲכָ֑ה וְאֵת֙ כָּל־כִּנְר֔וֹת עַ֖ל כָּל־אֶ֥רֶץ נַפְתָּלִֽי׃

controles.web: Ben Hadad listened to king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
controles.kjv: So Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel–beth–maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
controles.livre: E Ben-Hadade consentiu com o rei Asa, e enviou os príncipes dos exércitos que tinha contra as cidades de Israel, e feriu a Ijom, e a Dã, e a Abel-Bete-Maaca, e a toda Quinerete, com toda a terra de Naftali.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ בַּעְשָׁ֔א וַיֶּחְדַּ֕ל מִבְּנ֖וֹת אֶת־הָֽרָמָ֑ה וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּתִרְצָֽה׃

controles.web: When Baasha heard of it, he left off building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
controles.livre: E ouvindo isto Baasa, deixou de edificar a Ramá, e ficou em Tirsa.

versos.hebraico: וְהַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָסָ֜א הִשְׁמִ֤יעַ אֶת־כָּל־יְהוּדָה֙ אֵ֣ין נָקִ֔י וַיִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת־אַבְנֵ֤י הָֽרָמָה֙ וְאֶת־עֵצֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּעְשָׁ֑א וַיִּ֤בֶן בָּם֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֔א אֶת־גֶּ֥בַע בִּנְיָמִ֖ן וְאֶת־הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃

controles.web: Then king Asa made a proclamation to all Judah; no one was exempted: and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and king Asa built therewith Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
controles.kjv: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
controles.livre: Então o rei Asa convocou a todo Judá, sem excetuar ninguém; e tiraram de Ramá a pedra e a madeira com que Baasa edificava, e edificou o rei Asa com ele a Gibeá de Benjamim, e a Mispá.

versos.hebraico: וְיֶ֣תֶר כָּל־דִּבְרֵֽי־אָ֠סָא וְכָל־גְּב֨וּרָת֜וֹ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה וְהֶֽעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֔ה הֲלֹֽא־הֵ֣מָּה כְתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה רַ֚ק לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָת֔וֹ חָלָ֖ה אֶת־רַגְלָֽיו׃

controles.web: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
controles.kjv: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
controles.livre: Os demais de todos os feitos de Asa, e toda sua fortaleza, e todas as coisas que fez, e as cidades que edificou, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá? Mas no tempo de sua velhice enfermou de seus pés.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אָסָא֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵר֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו בְּעִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

controles.web: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: E descansou Asa com seus pais, e foi sepultado com seus pais na cidade de Davi seu pai: e reinou em seu lugar Josafá seu filho.

versos.hebraico: וְנָדָ֣ב בֶּן־יָרָבְעָ֗ם מָלַךְ֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנָתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.
controles.kjv: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
controles.livre: E Nadabe, filho de Jeroboão, começou a reinar sobre Israel no segundo ano de Asa rei de Judá; e reinou sobre Israel dois anos.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אָבִ֔יו וּ֨בְחַטָּאת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: He did that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.
controles.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
controles.livre: E fez o que era mau diante dos olhos do SENHOR, andando no caminho de seu pai, e em seus pecados com que fez pecar a Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְשֹׁ֨ר עָלָ֜יו בַּעְשָׁ֤א בֶן־אֲחִיָּה֙ לְבֵ֣ית יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר וַיַּכֵּ֣הוּ בַעְשָׁ֔א בְּגִבְּת֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וְנָדָב֙ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל צָרִ֖ים עַֽל־גִּבְּתֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were laying siege to Gibbethon.
controles.kjv: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
controles.livre: E Baasa filho de Aías, o qual era da casa de Issacar, fez conspiração contra ele: e feriu-o Baasa em Gibetom, que era dos filisteus: porque Nadabe e todo Israel tinham cercado a Gibetom.

versos.hebraico: וַיְמִתֵ֣הוּ בַעְשָׁ֔א בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁלֹ֔שׁ לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

controles.web: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him, and reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: Matou-o, pois, Baasa no terceiro ano de Asa rei de Judá, e reinou em seu lugar.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י כְמָלְכ֗וֹ הִכָּה֙ אֶת־כָּל־בֵּ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֔ם לֹֽא־הִשְׁאִ֧יר כָּל־נְשָׁמָ֛ה לְיָרָבְעָ֖ם עַד־הִשְׁמִד֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַד־עַבְדּ֖וֹ אֲחִיָּ֥ה הַשִּׁילֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him; according to the saying of Yahweh, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the Lord, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
controles.livre: E quando ele veio ao reino, feriu toda a casa de Jeroboão, sem deixar alma vivente dos de Jeroboão, até exterminá-lo, conforme à palavra do SENHOR que ele falou por seu servo Aías silonita;

versos.hebraico: עַל־חַטֹּ֤אות יָרָבְעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּכַעְס֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְעִ֔יס אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger.
controles.kjv: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger.
controles.livre: Por causa dos pecados de Jeroboão que ele havia cometido, e com os quais fez pecar a Israel; e por sua provocação com que provocou à ira ao SENHOR Deus de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י נָדָ֖ב וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
controles.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
controles.livre: Os demais dos feitos de Nadabe, e todas as coisas que fez, não está tudo escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?

versos.hebraico: וּמִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֜ה בֵּ֣ין אָסָ֗א וּבֵ֛ין בַּעְשָׁ֥א מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל־יְמֵיהֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
controles.kjv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
controles.livre: E havia guerra entre Asa e Baasa, rei de Israel, durante todo o tempo deles.

versos.hebraico: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁלֹ֔שׁ לְאָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ בַּעְשָׁ֨א בֶן־אֲחִיָּ֤ה עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּתִרְצָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבַּ֖ע שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.
controles.kjv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
controles.livre: No terceiro ano de Asa, rei de Judá, começou a reinar Baasa, filho de Aías, sobre todo Israel em Tirsa; e reinou vinte e quatro anos.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֔ם וּ֨בְחַטָּאת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: He did that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.
controles.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
controles.livre: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, e andou no caminho de Jeroboão, e em seu pecado com que fez pecar a Israel.
